skill.summary: Monitors OpenClaw gateway every 3 hours, auto-restarts if unresponsive, diagnoses startup issues, and rotates logs with 7-day retention.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Adds automatic monitoring and smart restart for the OpenClaw gateway.
- Checks gateway health every 3 hours and restarts if unresponsive.
- Diagnoses issues if the gateway fails to start.
- Implements 7-day log rotation and detailed logging.
- Handles "already running" errors gracefully.
- No manual configuration needed; setup is automatic.
